title: The Archive Pulse | ECHO//100 Episode 3
description:
Kavi navigates a city turned against him after his face appears on every digital billboard. He discovers that his companion Mira holds the secret to his own mysterious origins. Episode 3 of ECHO//100: ARC. This story is an original work of fiction created with the assistance of artificial intelligence.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: Null’s pixelated hand tears through the phone, dragging the arcade floor into a digital abyss.
scenes.caption: Null emerges from screen
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in red hoodie backing away from a glowing phone screen, jagged purple pixels forming a claw, abandoned neon arcade background, vertical 9:16.

scenes.text: Kavi sprints into neon rain as every city screen displays a face in pure terror.
scenes.caption: Kavi's face everywhere
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi running through wet city streets, giant digital billboards reflecting his face, blue holographic rain, vertical 9:16.

scenes.text: Sirens wail while authorities close in, treating the existence of Kavi as a system breach.
scenes.caption: Authorities closing in
scenes.image_prompt: Police drones hovering above Kavi, red searchlights scanning the alleyway, Kavi hiding behind a rusted dumpster, vertical 9:16.

scenes.text: Byte pulses frantically, projecting a complex, glowing map of the Red Door’s hidden internal architecture.
scenes.caption: Byte displays map
scenes.image_prompt: Byte the floating robot with cyan face, orange antenna glowing, projecting a complex 3D holographic map, Kavi watching intently, vertical 9:16.

scenes.text: Mira flickers into view, her teal coat shimmering as she blocks a strike from Null.
scenes.caption: Mira fights Null
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in teal holographic coat shielding Kavi, deflecting jagged purple energy from Null, city grid background, vertical 9:16.

scenes.text: Mira is no rogue program, but the fail-safe a future version of Kavi built earlier.
scenes.caption: Mira is the fail-safe
scenes.image_prompt: Close up on Mira, face glowing with soft blue light, looking at Kavi with recognition, vertical 9:16.

scenes.text: The shadow of Kavi stands still beneath a streetlamp, pointing silently toward the Red Door.
scenes.caption: Shadow points the way
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi's shadow detached from his feet on the sidewalk, pointing at a mysterious heavy red door in a wall, vertical 9:16.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches into a pocket and pulls out a physical key, despite never touching it.
scenes.caption: The mysterious key
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi's hand holding a glowing ornate metallic key, the Red Door looming in the background, vertical 9:16.
